blocks.text: Some of the smartest choices are made before there is any guarantee they will work. For Ace Gapuz, one of those choices was believing in creators before “creator economy” was even a familiar phrase. At a time when blogging was still largely considered a hobby and social media was only beginning to find its footing in the Philippines, Gapuz saw something others were only beginning to notice: ordinary people could build communities, create influence, and eventually turn their passions into meaningful opportunities. She chose to invest in that idea. Years later, that choice has grown into Blogapalooza, one of the pioneering […]...
